label: PF Backlog 535
title: RCCA: scheduler eligibility deadlock - dependency map excluded closed items + blocked on advisory RELATED
body:
## Problem
After grooming+approving the backlog, /wg work claimed nothing (0 eligible). Two scheduler defects:
1. The dependency map (by_id) was built from OPEN items only (next_eligible + eligible_backlog), so a dependency on a COMPLETED item read as 'unmet' (fail-closed) and blocked the item.
2. eligible() treated EVERY dependency type as blocking, including advisory RELATED edges.
Net effect: the whole backlog deadlocked (102 unmet-dependency blocks) even though 13 real roots existed.

## Root cause (5-Why)
1. Nothing eligible. 2. Roots blocked by 'unmet dependency'. 3. by_id lacked closed items AND all dep types blocked. 4. next_eligible/eligible_backlog built by_id from list_open only; eligible did not filter by dep type. 5. No test asserted a completed dependency is satisfied or that RELATED is non-blocking.

## Fix
- by_id includes open + CLOSED items (so terminal deps are satisfied) in next_eligible + eligible_backlog.
- eligible() blocks only on REQUIRES/BLOCKS; RELATED is advisory (never blocks); flat deps/blocked_by still block (backward-compat); unknown refs still block (fail-closed).

## In scope
- core/scheduler.py: by_id (open+closed) + dep-type filtering
- tests

## Out of scope
- changing AI grooming dependency inference
- required_state semantics (informational)

## Acceptance
- A dependency on a completed item is satisfied; RELATED never blocks; REQUIRES on an open item blocks; unknown dep blocks.
- Real backlog reports >0 eligible (roots).
